Delete Public Content

SupportPrivacyTermsCommunity Guidelines

You can remove your public content or ask us for help.

Delete in the app

Open About → My submissions to delete a pending or approved post or reply. To remove your anonymous account and all authored posts and replies, open About and tap "Delete my anonymous account and content." Deleting the app does not automatically delete public content. Delete your account first or contact support.

Send a deletion request

Email typhoon.lab.app@gmail.com with:

  • “Unsend content deletion request” in the subject.
  • The exact text, or the first and last sentence.
  • Whether it was a post or reply.
  • The approximate date, time, category, and related post.
  • A screenshot, if available.

Do not send identity documents unless we ask for them.

What happens next

We will search for the content and may ask for more details. Older content may not have a verified author identifier, so we may need the exact text and approximate time. We may remove content when the request reasonably identifies it and removal does not conflict with a legal or safety obligation.

We aim to respond within 30 days. Removal from active systems may not remove copies saved by other people, and limited copies may remain temporarily in backups or legal and safety records.

Private drafts

Text released through the private shred, burn, or dissolve options is not uploaded to our community database, so there is no server copy for us to delete.
